aspect: Recovery depends on something you may no longer control
description: Resets route to an email or phone. Losing the phone, changing the number or letting an old address lapse breaks everything downstream of it.
energy_note: A number you gave up in 2019 now holds your whole identity.

aspect: There is no human to appeal to
description: Consumer platforms at scale have no meaningful appeal path. The automated decision is the final decision.
energy_note: Adjudicated by a system with no counter.

aspect: SCENARIO - the authenticator and the broken phone
description: The phone dies. The authenticator was not backed up. The recovery codes are in a password manager whose second factor is the authenticator. Nine accounts, including the bank and the tax portal, are now unreachable.
energy_note: A perfectly secure system, with you outside it.

description: Banking, tax, health records, work and government identity increasingly run through accounts. Opting out of the fragility means opting out of participating.
